Swamishri welcomed at JFK Airport At 2.30 pm (GMT) Swamishri departed from London’s Heathrow airport towards New York. At 4.10 pm (American Standard Time) Swamishri’s plane landed at JFK airport in New York. Swamishri was given a red carpet welcome at Terminal 4. For the first time ever, a welcome assembly was arranged for Swamishri in Terminal 4. Yagnavallabh Swami, Dr. K.C. Patel and Senator Balboni garlanded Swamishri. Several other dignitaries and officials also welcomed Swamishri and received his blessings. Thereafter Swamishri was given a police escort by the FBI to the BAPS Swaminarayan Mandir in Flushing.

Nitinbhai, a volunteer for the assembly arrangement in the mandir, expressed his feelings before Swamishri in not being able to listen to the spiritual discourses because of his seva. He asked as to what was important, doing seva or listening to the discourse.

Swamishri advised, “One must do one’s seva but one should also sit and listen to the discourse for thirty to forty-five minutes. This will enable one to absorb spiritual knowledge and understanding. In doing mere seva one declines when someone insults or tells one off. Whereas, listening to spiritual discourses will endow one with spiritual knowledge and understanding so that one will not fall back.”
Taking leave from the London mandir, Pramukh Swami Maharaj set off for the airport. The car left the mandir grounds.

The driver, Nitinbhai, said, "This time we had to make the arrangements for the assembly. A thought came into my mind then: we made the arrangements, but did not get the chance to sit in the satsang assembly. So I felt regret, wondering whether seva is more important or listening to the discourse."

Swamishri said, "Seva certainly has to be done, but at the time of the discourse one should sit for at least half an hour or three quarters of an hour. Only then do the words of knowledge and understanding sink into the soul. Otherwise, if someone sometimes says something, one feels hurt. But if one listens to discourses, then knowledge and understanding keep one thinking, 'It is fine, let him say it, we have come to do seva, haven't we!' If there is no knowledge and understanding, one leaves the seva and goes away. If there is understanding and knowledge, the mind does not fall back from satsang."

Today Pramukh Swami Maharaj was to leave London for New York. Nainesh Patel, a youth volunteer sitting in front, said to Swamishri, "It feels as if twenty days have passed in the blink of an eye, we did not even notice. How can this be allowed!"
What Nainesh meant was that Swamishri should stay longer.
Swamishri said, "It is being allowed, my good man! We came here from India in the blink of an eye, and we will blink and reach America."

Nainesh said, "You are the Gunatit form. You can take as many forms as you wish. Leave one form here as you go! Since Lord Dholakia said so, you are now a citizen here. This is your home. You should not leave here now."

With a natural note of detachment, Swamishri said, "My good man! Wherever we go is home." Then, explaining further, he said, "Akshardham has no measure of above and below, right! Wherever you look there is Akshardham, so where does the question of anything else arise? Whether we go to a hut or a palace, wherever we go, Akshardham is in all of them, so why fall into narrowness? We have become international. Then why belong to London or anywhere else? We belong to Akshardham!"
Swamishri seemed, out of grace, to be speaking of his own divinity.
Nainesh said, "Bapa! Let us experience Akshardham just once."

Swamishri said, "Where is the question of experiencing it! If one believes oneself to be aksharrup, then we are already seated in Akshardham. Then there is no looking here and there, and no other desire remains."
As a last piece of advice at parting, Swamishri seemed to be speaking about becoming worthy of spirituality through and through.

Nainesh said, "When Arjun was shown the cosmic form, he said, 'Give me darshan of you as you are; I do not have the strength to see the cosmic form.' In the same way, we do not have the strength either."

Swamishri said, "Happiness comes only in that. If we showed dazzling radiance, one would fall over in that radiance and tremble as Arjun did. That is why, when Shriji Maharaj comes in human form, there is happiness. He sits with us, gets up, talks and walks. Yogiji Maharaj did things in that way, so we felt happy. If they live like us, we feel at ease. Otherwise, if five thousand watts of power were coming out, what happiness would there be? If one cannot even look, how can one go near?! When Narsinh avatar was taken, who apart from Prahlad could go near? In the same way, only when God and the Sant become like us do we find happiness."

A thal (plate of food) lay before Swamishri, yet he was so absorbed in giving this discourse that he was not the least aware of what he was eating. This attachment of Swamishri to talks about God touched everyone.

st.t: Pramukh Swami Maharaj departs London - Friday 14 May 2004
w: Pramukh Swami Maharaj departed London on Friday 14 May after a stay of 21 days that fulfilled devotees beyond expectations. Swamishri went on to New York for a three-month vicharan in the USA and Canada. On the final day, Swamishri gave darshan to all the devotees both young and old and even had time at the airport to remind everyone to constantly remember the moments shared during the vicharan.

After Swamishri had completed his morning puja he gave the bhagwati diksha on African soil for the first time in the history of East Africa Satsang Mandal to two parshads, originally born and brought up in Nairobi. They were named Sadhu Gnanyogidas and Sadhu Siddhayogidas. An annakut of 738 food items was offered to Thakorji in the mandir shrine. Swamishri performed arti and blessed the devotees for their devotional efforts. In the evening assembly a drama on Yogiji Maharaj’s divine personality, entitled ‘Yogi Charitam’, was performed by BAPS children, teenagers and youths. In conclusion Swamishri blessed the assembly, “Yogiji Maharaj’s every action was pure and divine. He was child-like. Whosoever has had his darshan can never forget him. In his discourses there was humour and joy. He used to give a memorable pat on the shoulders of all. “His purity and saintliness touched all – whether the person was a devotee or not. A person of any religion experienced divinity in him. There was no ostentation in his life. He never believed and felt that he was great, that he was a great person or that he knew a lot”

To please Bhagwan Swaminarayan and Guru Pramukh Swami Maharaj children, youths and senior devotees perform austerities, pilgrimages or other devotional means. The spiritual endeavors performed by the devotees during Swamishri's visit to the local centers are congratulatory and worthy of recognition. It also reflects Swamishri's divinity for inspiring such spiritual efforts in children, teenagers and devotees.

Several bank managers from various branches of the Bank of Baroda came for Swamishri’s darshan and blessings. They had all seen Swaminarayan Akshardham in New Delhi and were very impressed. Mr Kabra, a manager of a branch from Kisumu, asked, “What type of power do you possess that at the utterance of a single word so many get ready to do what you wish?” Swamishri replied humbly, “God is the doer of all works. It is due to his and our guru’s grace that things are done. Without God’s inspiration nothing can be accomplished. God is the essence.” Mr Kabra asked, “Now which other unique work do you intend to do in your life?” Swamishri said, “I am doing what God inspires me. He is the doer. Whatever that is being done is all planned by God.” Thereafter Swami explained how Akshardham was built through the wish of Yogiji Maharaj.

Jitubhai, a satsangi, used to tell Chandreshbhai, who worked for him, every day to come to satsang. He would reply, "It is not in my karma to come there." Today, when he came for darshan, Jitubhai told Pramukh Swami Maharaj about this. Swamishri said to him, "When you go to work, or go to eat and drink, or go to sleep, do you think, 'It is not in my karma'? This is something to be done for the soul. No karma comes in the way of doing satsang. On the contrary, whatever bad karmas there are get removed. So do come to satsang." Saying this, he made him a disciple of Maharaj.

Prior to his morning puja Swamishri performed the arti of a symbolic annakut festival before Thakorji. More than 425 food items were arranged before Thakorji in all the three sanctums, abhishek mandapam and guru shikhars . At 4.15 p.m. Swamishri, prior to his departure from the mandir, went for Thakorji’s darshan. The scorching summer heat was 45°C. Thousands of devotees had assembled on the mandir grounds for Swamishri’s darshan since 3.00 p.m. Swamishri gave darshan to all before departing from Ahmedabad at 5.05 p.m. He landed in Jamnagar at 5.35 p.m. There he performed pujan of the first pillar of the mandir mandapam . After blessing the devotees Swamishri departed at 6.30 p.m. Swamishri was welcomed with garlands by Kothari Dharmakunvar Swami and Kothari Jnanprasad Swami.

Pramukh Swami Maharaj was having his meal. The sadhus sitting in front talked about the illnesses caused by food in today's age of adulteration. From illnesses the talk turned to medicines, and from there to what methods scientists are trying today to become immortal.

After listening to all this talk, Swamishri finally summed it up and said, "If none of those who are living ever died, there would be no room left to put a foot on the earth. That is why God has made this arrangement. Know for certain that from the moment of birth... sooner or later death certainly comes. That is God's order."

Today he was to leave in the evening. Pramukh Swami Maharaj was to go to Bhadra by air via Jamnagar. The time to leave was 4:30, but such was the devotion of the devotees, wanting the closest darshan of Swamishri even in the last moments, that from 3:00, in unbearable heat, the mandir premises had begun to overflow. At this time Ahmedabad was burning at 40 degrees (C). In such terrible heat, where a papad placed on the floor would get roasted, to throng from 3:00 for darshan of Swamishri passing by is an extraordinary thing.

When Swamishri came out for darshan at 4:15, embers seemed to be raining from the sky. For Swamishri too this experience was something new at this stage of life, because mostly Swamishri does not have to go out at such times. Moreover, going out in such heat at this age is also a great hardship. Giving darshan to everyone, when Swamishri came to the mandir courtyard, he made a gesture on seeing the devotees standing in the heat. On the terrace too, devotees were sitting for darshan without any shelter. Seeing that, Swamishri also showed his amazement. After the darshan of Thakorji, casting his gracious glance on everyone, Swamishri sat in the car.
Even in the unbearable heat, one could enjoy the shared experience of Swamishri's divine attraction and the devotees' divine love.

Pramukh Swami Maharaj came from Jamnagar to Gunatitnagar, Bhadra. Here, by Swamishri's inspiration, command and blessings, a beautiful carved mandir had been built on the birthplace of Aksharbrahman Gunatitanand Swami. Swamishri had come here for the installation of this mandir.

At night, while he was having his meal, the senior sadhus were recalling memories of the mandir's installation by Yogiji Maharaj in 1969. Someone said, "On the day of the installation, the seva of the flag was done by Ravjibhai Dudhwala of Anand."
On hearing this, Swamishri asked Kothari Dharmakunvar Swami, "Shambhu (Anand) has also done seva in the new mandir, so he has been called, hasn't he?"
Hearing the answer yes, Swamishri was satisfied.
